description: Linux kernel driver source code for the Avila hardware watchdog timer, including initialization, control, and interaction with hardware GPIOs.

methods.name: wdt_refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the watchdog timer, resets the hardware GPIO, and reschedules the timer.

methods.name: wdt_enable
methods.description: Enables the watchdog timer, initializes counter, and configures GPIO.

methods.name: wdt_disable
methods.description: Disables the watchdog timer and re-enables clock output.

methods.name: avila_wdt_open
methods.description: Handles opening the watchdog device, sets in-use status, and enables the watchdog.

methods.name: avila_wdt_write
methods.description: Handles write operations to the device, resets the watchdog, and can extend timeout.

methods.name: avila_wdt_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for support, status, keepalive, and timeout settings.

methods.name: avila_wdt_release
methods.description: Handles closing the device, disables watchdog if allowed.

methods.name: avila_wdt_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog timer, registers device, and starts the timer.

methods.name: avila_wdt_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the watchdog device and timer on module exit.
